reason: I use AI at work all day, but I don't let it near my actual money, and I'm not going to start with a cartoon pet that 'invests and pays for me'. The broker partner isn't even named yet and there's no price, so there's nothing real for me to sign up for.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money. Limits and a kill switch don't change the fact that I'd be letting an AI move real dollars on its own, and a downloadable log only tells me what went wrong after it already happened.
would_change_my_mind: A named, regulated broker holding the money, plus a mode where the AI only suggests and never acts without my tap, with a track record from other people running it on real money for a year.
